# #190 - Hissar och AI-dissar

**Feed**: affarsvarlden-analys  
**Published**: 2026-09-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Affärsvärlden's podcast #190 reviews several Nordic industrials and information-services names against the backdrop of the AI/datacenter boom. The hosts issue a BUY on elevator maker Alimak (stable, high-margin industrial-lift core plus cyclical construction/facade upside), while staying NEUTRAL on Boliden (large Nexa acquisition in South America, already seen as fully valued), Karnov (AI fears overdone but bid speculation baked in), ABB (AI winner now looking richly valued at ~22x EBIT) and ferry operator Tallink (10% yield but pressured market and minority-unfriendly owners).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ALIG — Alimak | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Stable high-margin industrial-hoist core plus margin upside in cyclical construction/facade; low ~10-11x forward valuation with no acquisition premium priced in.

#### Reasoning

Industrial segment (~23% of sales, 24-25% margins) is a cash machine and stable base. Construction and facade units are in a cyclical trough with margin targets (10%→20%, 13%→18%), phased-out loss projects and new management review offering upside. Sum-of-parts on peer multiples (Kone/Schindler ~17x) values the industrial arm at nearly half the company. M&A optionality via ProBell adds upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if construction/facade margin targets are not reached
- if building cycle deteriorates further
- if new acquisitions (ProBell) prove value-destructive

> *"Det är lite det som vi bygger då köprådet i Alimak."*

---

### 🟡 BOL — Boliden | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large Nexa acquisition at cheap ~4.6x EV/EBIT 2027, but stock already seen as fully valued before the deal; value hinges on required return on risky South American assets.

#### Reasoning

Nexa adds cheap zinc cash flows and a South American platform, financed with shares (dilution) rather than debt. But Boliden was already deemed fully valued, and a high discount rate for the region makes it look full. Operational problems at Garpenberg and Odda draw analyst criticism. Prudent, zinc-focused strategy and Laver copper project are long-dated positives.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a high required return is applied to South American assets
- if Garpenberg/Odda operational problems worsen
- if zinc prices fall

> *"Vi är väl lite undesided fortfarande om aktien där, men vi har ett neutralt råd."*

---

### 🟡 KAR — Karnov | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

AI fears (-30%) seen as possibly overdone given unique legal content and 5-7% organic growth; strategic review with Goldman Sachs and takeover approaches put a small bid premium in the price.

#### Reasoning

Unique legal commentary data (Juno) underpins subscriptions; no visible AI erosion in numbers, with 5% (Nordic) to 7% (online) organic growth and dominant market shares. Southern Europe turnaround stalling and margin pressure from Juno Flow investment. ~14x earnings not demanding; bid optionality supports the stock but is already partly priced. More attractive if a bid fails and shares fall back.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a takeover bid fails and premium unwinds
- if AI reduces licenses/seats at clients
- if southern-Europe turnaround stays stalled

> *"Jag fegar ur lite grann. Vi har ett neutralt råd på det här."*

---

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

High-quality electrification/automation winner but re-rated to ~22x forward EBIT on the AI/datacenter narrative; risk/reward seen as skewed worse, advise awaiting.

#### Reasoning

Structural transformation lifted margins from ~10-12% to ~20%, well earned. But multiple expanded from ~18x to ~22x, largely on datacenter sentiment (only ~10% of sales). Being bullish requires believing the high multiple persists and the AI capex cycle keeps accelerating. Cheaper AI exposure exists (NVIDIA <22x). Long-term holders advised to trim, but outright sell deemed too aggressive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI/datacenter capex cycle peaks or slows
- if the elevated multiple compresses
- if concrete signs of cycle topping appear

> *"Det är därför vi har landat i att man ska avvakta med det här."*

---

### 🟡 TAL1T — Tallink | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

10% dividend yield and ~30% discount to fleet value with strong cash flow, but weak pressured Baltic ferry market, high autumn energy prices, and minority-unfriendly main owners.

#### Reasoning

Heavy vessel depreciation (~70 vs ~50 EBIT) makes cash flow far exceed operating profit; ~8x operating cash flow. Discount to fleet value gives downside protection since vessels can be sold/chartered. But market is ~70-80% of pre-pandemic, high energy prices pressure autumn, and owners have a reputation for favoring themselves over minorities. Neutral, tempting only on a very long horizon via dividends.

#### Sell Triggers

- if energy/oil prices spike sharply
- if main owners run related-party deals against minorities
- if passenger market weakens further

> *"Jag valde ändå ett neutralt råd. Jag blev lite småsugen på att äga det själv."*

---

### 🟠 VIK1V — Viking Line | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Previously found attractive on a large substance discount and cheap earnings power; referenced favorably versus Tallink but pays out much less.

#### Reasoning

Prior coverage flagged Viking Line as appealing given a big discount to fleet substance value and low earnings multiple. Compared with Tallink it distributes far less cash, so value realization is slower. Same Baltic market weakness applies. Not a fresh rating in this episode, but discussed positively as a watch idea.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Baltic passenger market deteriorates further
- if payout stays too low to realize substance value

> *"Vi har tidigare kollat på Viking Line och tyckte att det var rätt lockande."*
